chapter.title: Oda's Counter
subtitle: The Valley Scrip shop. Open from the moment the store reopens.
Cozy work pays Scrip; Scrip buys the dull half.
Stock widens as the wagon comes up the line.

quests.title: Read Oda's Board at the Counter
quests.subtitle: Scrip only. Every buy line restocks.
description: Oda: "Store's open. Shelves are thin and my ledger is thinner, but they're open. Cash is Scrip. I don't barter and I don't round up."

Buy anything on this board with Valley Scrip. Scrip comes from deliveries, festival baskets and closing a neighbour's story — her standing order pays eight for twenty-four wheat, once, and then that page is closed.
Every buy line below restocks. Buy a line as many times as you can pay for it.
One warning: keep two hundred Scrip back. The winter debt is a hundred and twenty, the Works Deed is eighty, and I do not get talked down.

tasks.title: Read the board and the prices under it

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Ten Scrip, on the house. That is the only time those three words happen in this store.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Oda's Counter is open
rewards.description: Next: buy the cheap tech now, the decor when the rail comes in — and keep 200 Scrip back for year two. Oda means it.

quests.title: Fill a Standing Order — 24 Wheat for 8 Scrip
quests.subtitle: 8 Scrip. Once.
description: Oda: "One standing order, filled once. After that the wheat goes on my shelf and the Scrip comes out of your work, not my ledger."
Put twenty-four wheat across the counter for eight Scrip, once. Every Scrip after this comes from deliveries, festival baskets and closing a neighbour's story.

quests.title: Buy 16 Andesite Casing — 10 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Cut at the mill through the dead weeks.
description: Oda: "Sixteen casings. Bram cuts them through the dead weeks when there is nothing else to do."
Ten Scrip. That is under a bounty's pay, and it is four minutes of your life you get back.

quests.title: Buy 32 Andesite Alloy — 8 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Andesite and iron nuggets, pressed flat.
description: Oda: "Thirty-two. Andesite and iron nuggets, pressed. The least interesting thing in this valley, and you will want a great deal of it."
Eight Scrip. Deliberately cheap — nobody's evening should be a press.

quests.title: Buy the Gearing Crate — 6 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Enough cog and belt for a whole lane.
description: Oda: "Sixteen cogs, eight large cogs, sixteen shafts, eight belts. I wrote that on the crate lid so neither of us counts it again."
Six Scrip. The crate exists so a kinetic line is a design problem, not a woodcutting problem.

quests.title: Buy the Seed Box — 4 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Five packets, and Marnie wrote the labels.
description: Oda: "Five packets, eight seeds each. Cabbage, tomato, corn, beetroot, pumpkin. Marnie writes the labels because mine are unreadable."
Four Scrip. Plant what the season allows and leave the rest in the box.

quests.title: Buy the Pantry Basket — 4 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Supper for the nights you forget to cook.
description: Oda: "Sixteen loaves, sixteen rice, eight beef. Marnie bakes it, I shelve it, you eat it standing over a millstone at two in the morning."
Four Scrip. It is the cheapest line on the board on purpose.

quests.title: Buy the Lamp Oil Crate — 6 Scrip
quests.subtitle: The line you buy in autumn, not January.
description: Oda: "Eight lanterns, eight candle holders, four road lamps. Josie bought this exact crate every autumn and I never had to ask what for."
Six Scrip. Nobody in this valley calls a lamp decoration.

quests.title: Buy a Crate of 16 Redstone Servos — 15 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Bram asks for these by name.
description: Oda: "Sixteen servos in a crate. I do not know what they do. I know Bram asks for them by name and I know how many are in the crate."
Fifteen Scrip. Every Thermal machine on your bench wants two of these and none of them are interesting.

quests.title: Buy 2 Spare Machine Frames — 25 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Somebody else's afternoon at the fan.
description: Oda: "Two frames. Washed silica, which means Nella's boat and a fan and an afternoon, and I have already spent that afternoon."
Twenty-five Scrip — the most expensive line on this shelf, because it is the one that saves the most time.

quests.title: Buy 8 RF Coils — 18 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Four of these and a frame make a cell.
description: Oda: "Eight coils. Silver and redstone, wound. Josie ordered a dozen, collected eight, and the other four are still on my books."
Eighteen Scrip. Tobin's silver goes in one end of this store and comes out of the other as coil.

quests.title: Buy 64 Duct and a Cell Frame — 12 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Carries the dynamo's power down the lane.
description: Oda: "Sixty-four duct, one cell frame. Duct is the only thing in this store I sell by the metre and I still count it by the piece."
Twelve Scrip. Run the lane, don't craft the lane.

quests.title: Buy the Furniture Page — 12 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Page four, new since the rail came in.
description: Oda: "Page four, and it only exists because there is a rail line now. Table, four chairs, a couch, a cupboard, two shelves, a nightstand."
Twelve Scrip a page. Order it as many times as you have rooms.

quests.title: Buy the Windows and Roofing Page — 12 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Page seven. Eight windows and a door.
description: Oda: "Page seven. Eight windows, four curtain rods, sixteen roof, a cottage door. It comes off the wagon in one crate and goes out in one."
Twelve Scrip. This is how a shell stops being a shell.

quests.title: Buy the Garden Page — 10 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Page nine, and Halden reads it for pleasure.
description: Oda: "Page nine. Eight flower boxes, eight planters, sixteen hedge, four saplings. Halden reads this page for pleasure, which is Halden."
Ten Scrip. Nothing on this page does anything, and the square looks wrong without it.

quests.title: Buy the Lighting Page — 14 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Page eleven, first asked for at the Supper.
description: Oda: "Page eleven. Twelve sconces, eight lanterns, eight soul lanterns, sixteen rope, four shelves. It has only come up since the Supper."
Fourteen Scrip. Forty posts on the road and none of them light the inside of a house.

quests.title: Buy the Livestock Order — 20 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Counted at both ends of the wagon.
description: Oda: "One cow, one sheep, two crates of hens. They come up on the wagon in crates and they are counted at both ends, mine and yours."
Twenty Scrip. Right-click a crate inside the pen, not outside it.

quests.title: Buy the Rare Seed Case — 16 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Kept under the counter, in a tin.
description: Oda: "In a tin under the counter. Torchflower, pitcher pod, glow berries, sweet berries, coffee. Two of these I sell and never saw grow."
Sixteen Scrip. Wisp brought three of the five up out of the marsh.

quests.title: Buy a Reactor Casing Bundle — 40 Scrip
quests.subtitle: The internals bundle comes after this one.
description: Oda: "Sixteen reactor casing, eight turbine casing. Her notes make them craftable; my wagon brings them. They came home from the tower."
Forty Scrip — the dearest line I keep. A vessel is a lot of identical grey blocks and none of them are the interesting part.

quests.title: Buy the Reactor Internals Bundle — 35 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Everything the vessel holds, rods included.
description: Oda: "Eight fuel rods, two control rods, eight glass, one rotor bearing, eight blades, four shafts. I read that off the lid every time."
Thirty-five Scrip. Bram checked the list twice and then checked my arithmetic.

quests.title: Buy the Storage Bundle — 30 Scrip
quests.subtitle: The storage net's dull half, crated.
description: Oda: "Four cells, four components, eight processors of the calculating sort, thirty-two cable. None of it is a decision."
Thirty Scrip. Buy the boring half; build the half that thinks.

quests.title: Buy a Plushie Token — 10 Scrip
quests.subtitle: Pip has spent eleven of these.
description: Oda: "One token, one shelf, one plushie of your choosing. Pip has spent eleven of these. I have written every one of them down."
Ten Scrip. Spend the token on Josie's Shelf.

quests.title: Buy Your Own Copy of the Deed — 150 Scrip
quests.subtitle: 150 Scrip, and the Deed already signed.
description: Oda: "The Deed you bought is the town's. This one is yours — same wording, same witnesses, my hand instead of Bram's, markers in the box."
Needs the Works Deed already signed, and 150 Valley Scrip on the counter.
One hundred and fifty is not a price, it is a filing fee with an opinion. Buy it again and a second pair of hands has their own.

tasks.title: The town's Works Deed already signed

rewards.title: Filed, in duplicate
rewards.description: Next: box your own site with the four Markers in the crate. Two copies of the Deed is how a thing survives one of us leaving.
